notes: Link-firehose only, and a self-pair ceiling. LXMF-rs fields no single node (single-packet proofs are unimplemented), and its link wire — plain link data — interoperates only with itself (one-directionally with Prns). This surfaces a real dynamic: 'link' is not one protocol across the family — go proves single-style link packets, Leviculum carries a Channel multiplexer, Prns/LXMF-rs exchange plain link data — so cross-impl link pairings only work where those sub-protocols line up. Delivery on the receiver is counted directly; the reliable in-order link gives the sender delivered==sent with no per-message RTT.
